name: Rookit English Mock Dataset
provenance: Original AI-generated mock data created for this project; no company documents or external datasets used.
evaluation_limitations: Development smoke tests reuse the challenge scenarios and positive sample answers. They are not a held-out benchmark and cannot establish generalization.
generation: Original 12 exercise IDs and facts preserved; Korean question text applied; 288 deterministic template-based exercises generated by scripts/expand_mock_data.py. Paired rewrite/compose exercises share a scenario.
